issue.title: Retire service_host
issue.description: Gate the per-machine SASE service host and scheduler ownership handover while the service platform phases land.

task_type_fields.remove_when: The service host, scheduler handover, platform unit integration, and Services tab are complete and verified so the legacy off branch can be deleted.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Service host commands fail with an opt-in diagnostic and existing axe lifecycle commands keep their legacy behavior.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: The service host owns configured machine service procs and the scheduler control CLI routes through it.

payload.entry: Removed with sase-11y.10.1.2: FeatureFlag.service_host enum member, its registry definition, and its generated schema property are deleted (just sync-feature-flags-schema); every gate that read it is gone (scheduler handler, service control plane + service_handler, service platform blockers, init, doctor, mobile gateway, TUI collector/render/actions/widgets/modals) and the former On branch now runs unconditionally. Legacy scheduler Off branches (_handle_legacy_scheduler, scheduler restart --verify-timeout / stop --force) and the TUI direct axe start/stop/restart path are deleted. Verified an unregistered SASE_FEATURE_FLAGS key stays a warning: SASE_FEATURE_FLAGS='{"service_host": true}' sase flag list and sase service status both exit 0 (flag list prints 'warning: unknown feature flag service_host ignored').
